opening.argument: The material presents Forsage as an earnings-platform opportunity and invites viewers to contact the promoter, but those promotional elements do not establish a concrete deceptive mechanism. The title calls it the “Best Earnings Platform” and a “Life-changing Oprtunity,” while directing viewers to “Contact Now” at a phone number. The description refers to “howtoearnfromforsage,” “howtoopenforsage,” and “nonworkingincome,” showing broad promotional language about pursuing income through the platform. The visual evidence likewise shows Forsage-related promotional decals on a car, including “FORSAGE IS THE BEST.” Yet the supplied material shows no specific payment flow, recruitment hierarchy, credential request, or other defined mechanism demonstrating deception.
